gripOrHq.title: Networking
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [9]. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Running Interference
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. During that run, the Corp must pay [X], in addition to the normal cost, to rez each piece of ice, where X is the rez cost of that piece of ice. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Finders Keepers
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Roll three dice. Gain that many bits.

heapOrArchives.title: MS-todon
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1]: Break sentry subroutine. [1]: +1 strength. The first time during each run that you break a sentry subroutine with MS-todon, lose all bits from all stealth cards, if you can, and the Corp gives you a tag.

heapOrArchives.title: Superglue
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [T]: Derez a piece of ice. Use this ability only if you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice.

heapOrArchives.title: Finders Keepers
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Roll three dice. Gain that many bits.

heapOrArchives.title: Rent-I-Con
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

heapOrArchives.title: Schematics Search Engine
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, expose all of the Corp's installed cards.

heapOrArchives.title: Panzer Run
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [4] and draw two cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Gypsy™ Schedule Analyzer
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If run is successful, do not access any cards. Instead, reveal cards one at a time from R&D until you reveal an agenda card or there are no cards left in R&D. Store the agenda, if any, in HQ and shuffle the other revealed cards, if any, into R&D.

scoreArea.title: Marked Accounts
scoreArea.rulesText: When Runner accesses Marked Accounts, give Runner a tag, even if it is not installed. If Marked Accounts is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

rig.title: Rent-I-Con
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

rig.title: Executive File Clerk
rig.rulesText: [2],[T]: Look at all cards stored in HQ. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

rig.title: Sandbox Dig
rig.rulesText: [3], [T]: Look at the top three cards stored in R&D. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

scoreArea.title: Fetal AI
scoreArea.rulesText: When Runner accesses Fetal AI, do 2 Net damage, even if it is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses Fetal AI from the Archives. If Fetal AI is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you. Runner must pay 2 to steal Fetal AI, in addition to any other costs.

scoreArea.title: Fetal AI
scoreArea.rulesText: When Runner accesses Fetal AI, do 2 Net damage, even if it is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses Fetal AI from the Archives. If Fetal AI is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you. Runner must pay 2 to steal Fetal AI, in addition to any other costs.

ice.title: Nerve Labyrinth
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Setup!
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Setup!, it does 2 Net damage, even if it is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If Setup! is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

root.title: Virus Test Site
root.rulesText: You may advance Virus Test Site before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Test Site, it does 2 Net damage per advancement counter on it, or 1 Net damage if it has no counters, even if it is not installed or rezzed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If Test Site is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

root.title: Setup!
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Setup!, it does 2 Net damage, even if it is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If Setup! is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

root.title: City Surveillance
root.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.
